name: Track Lindo website incidents and recoveries with confirmation checks and email digests

parameters.content:
## Lindo portfolio incident monitoring

### How it works
Every 30 minutes, discover your Lindo websites and check each public URL twice with HTTPS HEAD requests. Two failures open an incident; a healthy confirmation resolves it. A failure only in the second check keeps the previous state. Email only new incidents, recoveries or a seven-day digest to avoid repeated alerts.

### Setup
1. In **Configure monitoring**, replace both email placeholders and set **digestDays** (default 7).
2. Create HTTP Header Auth: name **Authorization**, value **Bearer YOUR_LINDO_API_KEY**. Select it only in **Lindo - list the website inventory**. Leave both public checks unauthenticated.
3. Connect SMTP to **Email the portfolio health report**. Use a sender address your provider permits.
4. Test manually, then activate and verify two scheduled runs. Static data persists only after successful active executions; manual tests do not establish a lasting baseline.

### Customization
Adjust the schedule for your portfolio and keep runs sequential. Use a database for concurrency or more than 1000 websites. Configure separate n8n error notifications for stopped runs.

### Limits
HEAD checks measure reachability, not content or continuous uptime. Redirects are not followed; 403/405 can indicate HEAD restrictions. Invalid URLs or incomplete inventories stop execution. Failed delivery may repeat an alert; removed websites are not marked recovered.

nodes.name: 4. Send changes and save the baseline

parameters.content:
## 4. Send changes and save the baseline
Email new incidents, recoveries or a due digest. The false branch skips email. Save the baseline after successful delivery, or immediately when no email is needed.

## 3. Confirm website availability
Make two unauthenticated HEAD checks with a wait between rounds. Keep both results to distinguish confirmed failures from transient errors.

## 2. Discover and validate Lindo websites
Connect Lindo Header Auth here only. Retrieve the complete inventory and reject malformed URLs before sending public requests.

## 1. Configure monitoring
Set the sender, reviewer and digest interval. Connect SMTP before activating the schedule.

for (const key of ['fromEmail','reviewerEmail']) { const v=String($json[key]||''); if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(v) || /\.(invalid|example)$/.test(v)) throw new Error('Configure '+key+' in the settings node before running.'); }
if(!Number.isInteger($json.digestDays)||$json.digestDays<1||$json.digestDays>30)throw new Error('digestDays must be 1–30');return [{json:$json}];

const items=$input.all(); const seen=new Map(); let total=0; for(const item of items){const r=item.json;if(r.success!==true||!Array.isArray(r.result?.list)||!Number.isFinite(r.result.total))throw new Error('Unexpected Lindo list response; no partial report will be produced.'); total=Math.max(total,r.result.total); for(const row of r.result.list)seen.set(row.website_id||row.page_id,row);} if(seen.size<total)throw new Error('List was truncated or changed during pagination. Retry the read-only workflow; maximum 100 pages.'); if(!seen.size)throw new Error('No matching API records found. Check the selected workspace or website.');return [...seen.values()].map((w)=>{const raw=String(w.domain||'').trim();const match=raw.match(/^(?:https:\/\/)?([a-zA-Z0-9.-]+)\/?$/);const h=match?.[1]?.toLowerCase();if(!h||!h.includes('.')||/^[0-9.]+$/.test(h)||h.split('.').some(label=>!label||label.length>63||!(/^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$/.test(label)))||/(^|\.)(localhost|local|internal|test|invalid|example)$/.test(h))throw new Error('Website '+w.website_id+' requires a valid public HTTPS domain.');return {json:{website_id:w.website_id,website_name:w.website_name||w.name||w.website_id,url:'https://'+h}};});

const first=$('Keep first check evidence').all(),results=$input.all();if(results.length!==first.length)throw new Error('Probe count mismatch');const rows=results.map((i,k)=>{const s=first[k].json,status=Number(i.json.statusCode||0),good=v=>v>=200&&v<300;const state=good(status)?'healthy':good(s.firstStatus)?'transient':'incident';return {website_id:s.website_id,website_name:s.website_name,url:s.url,state,firstStatus:s.firstStatus,status,detail:status?'HTTP '+status:String(i.json.error?.message||i.json.error||'No HTTP response').slice(0,200)};});return [{json:{rows,checked:rows.length,issues:rows.filter(r=>r.state==='incident').length}}];

const sites=$('Validate inventory and public URLs').all();if(sites.length!==$input.all().length)throw new Error('Probe count mismatch');return $input.all().map((i,k)=>({json:{...sites[k].json,firstStatus:Number(i.json.statusCode||0),firstError:String(i.json.error?.message||i.json.error||'').slice(0,200)}}));

const data=$json,now=Date.now(),s=$getWorkflowStaticData('global'),prior=s.portfolio||{sites:{},lastDigest:0};const events=[],next={};if(data.rows.length>1000)throw new Error('State limit: use a database above 1000 websites.');for(const r of data.rows){const old=prior.sites[r.website_id];const effective=r.state==='transient'?(old?.state||'healthy'):r.state;if(effective==='incident'&&old?.state!=='incident')events.push('NEW INCIDENT | '+r.website_name+' | '+r.url+' | '+r.detail);if(effective==='healthy'&&old?.state==='incident')events.push('RECOVERED | '+r.website_name+' | '+r.url);next[r.website_id]={state:effective,url:r.url};}const digestDue=now-prior.lastDigest>=$('Configure monitoring').first().json.digestDays*86400000;const notify=events.length>0||digestDue;const report=[digestDue?'Lindo portfolio digest':'Lindo incident update',new Date(now).toISOString(),data.checked+' websites checked; '+data.issues+' confirmed issues','',...events,'',...data.rows.map(r=>r.state.toUpperCase()+' | '+r.website_name+' | '+r.url+' | first '+r.firstStatus+', confirmation '+r.status+' | '+r.detail),'','Two HEAD samples, 30 seconds apart. Redirects are not followed. 403/405 may reflect HEAD restrictions. Transient failures do not open or resolve incidents. This is not continuous uptime monitoring.'].join('\n');return [{json:{...data,notify,events,digestDue,nextState:{sites:next,lastDigest:digestDue?now:prior.lastDigest},subject:'Lindo: '+events.length+' status changes'+(digestDue?' + portfolio digest':''),report}}];
